name: E.V. Enthusiast
qaNote: Portrait inspected. Preserve curly-haired bespectacled man, sage overshirt, cream EV hatchback and charging connector. Review car and driver continuity, exact long title readability and isolated cyan around vehicle.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

E.V. Enthusiast — Actually, It Charges Free.
IDENTITY: the exact slim adult man with tousled brown curls, short stubble, thin dark glasses, sage-green open overshirt, white T-shirt, dark cropped trousers and white sneakers. Preserve his ivory compact electric hatchback with black roof, dark windows and charging connector. No invented brand badges. He is the only person.
0–0.7s: complete character leans smugly against the car and twirls the charging connector once, pointing at it with his free hand.
0.7–2.5s: he plugs the connector into the car; its black cable instantly coils into a gigantic spring stretching thirty feet behind the vehicle. Camera pulls back hard to reveal the spring under impossible tension, then it RELEASES with an explosive gold electric shock ring. The car launches through the cyan void like a slingshot; he rides braced on the hood in a dramatic low surfing crouch, hand securely on the charging connector. Camera tracks alongside the rushing car, then whips in front as it swings into a huge controlled midair drift and stops close to camera. Powerful readable burst, finite black-ink-edged ivory/gold sparks and disconnected speed strokes. No street, floor, city, charger station or rectangular speed-line backdrop. Keep the vehicle silhouette and man intact.
2.5–3.5s: snap close to his absurdly calm smile, then reveal the car with him now casually leaning at its front fender. Exact title ACTUALLY, IT CHARGES FREE slams in three large readable comic lines, avoiding his face. No other text or numbers.
3.5–5s: the connector retracts neatly into his hand; his hair remains comically windswept while he gives the viewer the same smug little finger-point. The car settles with one last suspension bounce even in the cyan void. Hold a clean character-and-car hero tableau and stable title. SFX: connector click, huge elastic cable creak, electric slingshot KRAK, accelerating turbine whine, enormous braking whoosh, soft charging chime. No voice, dialogue or music.
